{{Quote|While the sacrifices are heavy, we fight knowing that a single spark of courage can ignite the fires of hope, and restore peace across the galaxy.|Jace Malcom|audio=SparkOfCourage-TORHope.flac|<ref name="Hope" />}}
'''Jace Malcom''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Republic trooper]], who served in the [[Republic Special Forces Division|Special Forces Division]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] and [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], and as the military's [[Supreme Commander (Republic)|Supreme Commander]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Malcom grew up on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Barcaria]], but left at a young age to join the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] defense forces. By [[3681 BBY]], he was serving as a [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]] aboard a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-run [[Korriban's orbital security station|space station]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] above [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. In that year, the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] returned to known [[Realspace/Legends|space]] to reclaim their [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|lost]] territory and exact revenge upon the Republic. During these early days of the ensuing [[Great Galactic War]], the Empire launched a [[Battle of Korriban|massive strike]] against the Jedi and Republic forces at Korriban in an effort to retake the world which had once been their holy [[Capital/Legends|capital]]. Malcom was caught in the battle, but managed to escape the onslaught alongside Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Satele Shan]] and incarcerated [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Nico Okarr]].

The war continued on for nearly three decades, during which time Malcom was inducted into the [[Republic Army]]'s Special Forces and granted [[Commander/Legends|command]] of the elite [[Havoc Squad|infantry unit 326]]. Under Malcom's leadership, the unit performed highly risky raids into enemy territory and earned the moniker of "Havoc Squad." At the height of the war, the [[Squad/Legends|squad]] was stationed on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] while the bulk of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] was elsewhere in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], combating the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. While he was stationed on the planet, Malcom and his [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] were swept up in the [[Battle of Alderaan]], a massive Imperial invasion of the tranquil world. As the Sith forces led by [[Darth Malgus]] ravaged the planet, Malcom and his comrades took to the forests of Alderaan to wage a guerrilla campaign against the Imperials. When [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Malgus turned his [[Army/Legends|army]] toward the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] capital [[City/Legends|city]], the commander and Havoc Squad positioned themselves to ambush the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and halt his advance. In a pitched battle in the forests outside of the capital, Havoc Squad routed the Imperial Army and Malcom fought and defeated Malgus himself with the aid of then-[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] Satele Shan.

Malcom's leadership during the battle earned him and Havoc Squad great prestige throughout the Republic and inspired continued resilience against the Sith. This fame attracted the attention of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Elin Garza]], with whom Malcom helped found a new, fully-fledged and independent Special Forces Division. Around the same time, Malcom fostered a secret relationship with Shan that ultimately culminated in a tense breakup. However, before their romantic relationship died, Malcom and Shan sired a son, [[Theron Shan]]. Malcom later received a promotion to the rank of colonel.

Following the end of the war and the implementation of a controversial [[Treaty of Coruscant|peace agreement]], Malcom was asked to return to Alderaan to oversee the efforts of Republic combatants in the [[Alderaan Civil War|bloody civil war]] that had engulfed the planet. As the [[Strategic Advisor to Alderaan for the Republic Army]], Malcom monitored [[Troop/Legends|troop]] deployments and tactical plans and maintained the military alliance between the Republic's armed forces and the noble [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]]. Under his supervision, the despotic [[King/Legends|King]] [[Bouris Ulgo]] was deposed and the Organas solidified their advantage in the war over the Imperial-backed [[House of Thul|House Thul]]. In [[3640 BBY]], Malcom was promoted to [[Supreme Commander (Republic)|Supreme Commander]] of the Republic Military, during which time he aided then-[[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]] in a battle against [[Darth Karrid]] and a renewed Sith offensive.

==Biography==
===Service in the Great Galactic War===
====Escape from Korriban====
{{Dialogue|Darach|The Sith Empire has returned. We must warn the Republic.|Malcom|Our shuttles can't outrun those fighters.|Okarr|Well&hellip;guess who's got the fastest ship in the sector?|attr=Jedi Master Kao Cen Darach, Corporal Jace Malcom, and Captain Nico Okarr discuss their escape from Korriban|src=<ref name="Return" />}}
[[File:Young_Jace_Malcolm_JMGD.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The young corporal Jace Malcom]]
Jace Malcom was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="UVG:UE">''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide: Updated and Expanded]]''</ref> from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Barcaria]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> who lived approximately three centuries after the [[Jedi Civil War]].<ref name="UVG:UE" /> Malcom was a strong supporter of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and joined the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] as an [[Republic Army|Army]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] around [[3683 BBY]].<ref name="AlderaanBonus">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Bonus Series|Alderaan}}</ref><ref name="3,683">During the Alderaan Bonus Series mission, Malcom states to the player character that the has "[f]''orty years of soldiering''" as experience. According to [https://web.archive.org/web/20110716175922/http://www.swtor.com/community/showthread.php?p=5365704 this forum post] from ''The Old Republic''{{'s}} lead writer, [[Daniel Erickson]], the game takes place approximately ten years after the signing of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], placing Malcom's comments in approximately [[3643 BBY]]. Simple math shows he therefore began his military career around [[3683 BBY]].</ref> Within two [[Standard year/Legends|years]], Malcom had been accepted into the ranks of the army's [[Republic trooper|elite troopers]], and by [[3681 BBY]],<ref name="Timeline6date">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire|int=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire}} indicates that the [[Battle of Korriban|Fall of Korriban]] takes place twenty-eight years before the [[Treaty of Coruscant]]. The Treaty is signed and ratified in [[3653 BBY]], as seen in ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'' and ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', confirming that the war and conflict over Korriban begin in [[3681 BBY]].</ref> Malcom had attained the rank of [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]] and was serving the government while stationed<ref name="Return">{{TORweb|url=info/media/trailers/return|text="Return"|int=Return (cinematic trailer)}}</ref> in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> aboard a [[Korriban's orbital security station|space station]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] above the Republic's protectorate world of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. There, Malcom served alongside fellow troopers and members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to maintain a constant vigil over the planet that had once been home to the [[Sith Empire/Legends|ancient Sith Empire]].<ref name="Return" /> In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reformed Empire]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] emerged from hiding in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] and launched a massive surprise assault against the Republic. The Imperials' [[Tingel Arm campaign|early campaigns]] focused primarily in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] distant [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]] region, and pulled the bulk of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic's navy]] away from their previous duties and into battle against the Sith.<ref name="Timeline 6">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire|int=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire}}</ref>

As a result of the fighting, Korriban lost most of its naval defenses, and was left with only a small defense force<ref name="Timeline 6" /> consisting of the Republic troopers aboard the space station<ref name="Return" /> and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] guardians who were watching over the Sith's holy world.<ref name="Timeline 6" /> While the battles elsewhere continued to rage, Malcom served under the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kao Cen Darach]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] learner, [[Satele Shan]]. Together, the three of them intercepted and arrested the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Nico Okarr]] on the surface of the planet<ref name="JoMGD">[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]</ref> and ferried him back to be detained aboard the Korriban station. The smuggler captain had been caught while transporting [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] and was being taken into custody when the young Shan sensed a disturbance in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. At that moment, a fleet of over thirty [[Harrower-class dreadnought|Sith battlecruisers]] emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] above Korriban and began to [[Battle of Korriban|assault]] the space station with [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and boarding parties. Master Darach decided that their first priority in the battle must be to escape the [[Horuset system|system]] and inform the larger Republic that the Empire had returned to its ancient [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. Although he agreed, Malcom insisted that none of the Republic's [[NR2 gully jumper]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] would be able to outrun the attacking [[Mark VI Supremacy-class starfighter|Imperial interceptors]]. Okarr, who had been listening in on the conversation, offered his own [[XS stock light freighter/Legends|XS stock light freighter]] the ''[[Redshifter]]'' as a means of escape,<ref name="Return" /> as it was allegedly the fastest ship in the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]].<ref name="Esstran">In [[Return (cinematic trailer)|''Return'']], Okarr claims that his vessel is the fastest in "the sector," evidently referring to the region Korriban occupied. According to ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', Korriban is located in the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]].</ref>

[[File:Trooper_and_smuggler.png|thumb|left|250px|Jace Malcom and Nico Okarr battle Sith forces.]]
The Jedi and troopers present accepted the offer and hastily fled towards the space station's [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]]. While Shan and her Master ran ahead to clear the landing zone, the corporal and a fellow trooper covered their rear by remaining behind in one of the station's corridors to engage Imperial boarding parties. As the two rounded a corner towards the hangar, an [[Imperial soldier]] launched a [[Missile/Legends|missile]] at them. The resulting blast temporarily incapacitated Malcom and [[Death/Legends|killed]] his comrade, which prompted Okarr to engage the Imperial troops himself. While he dispatched a number of approaching enemies, Malcom recovered and appropriated his fallen compatriot's [[Laser/Legends|laser]] [[Chaingun/Legends|chaingun]] to assist Okarr in destroying a pair of [[Sith war droid Mark I|Imperial assault droids]]. Although they cleared the corridor of hostiles, the Imperials again pushed forward, forcing the Okarr and Malcom to fall back into the hangar and seal the entry behind them. As they regrouped with Shan and Darach, an Imperial [[Fury-class Imperial interceptor|''Fury''-class interceptor]] landed in the hangar and deposited the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Vindican|Vindican]] and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Darth Malgus|Malgus]], onto the landing bay floor.<ref name="Return" />

Kao Cen Darach recognized the danger of the situation, and so ordered the corporal to join the smuggler in preparing his freighter for take-off while he and Shan [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|dueled]] the intruders. With the assistance of the captain's [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]], the two were able to get the ship running and lift off from the hangar floor. As they moved to flee the station, the captain maneuvered his ship into a hovering position so as to allow Shan and her Master an opportunity to board. Meanwhile, Malcom lowered the boarding ramp and [[Missile launcher/Legends|fired]] a missile at the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Pureblood]] Sith Lord, who was attempting to damage the vessel with blasts of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]]. The shot was ineffective, but allowed Okarr to move closer to the Jedi, the hangar [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]], and [[Realspace/Legends|space]] beyond. Master Darach ultimately elected to stay on the station and hold the Sith back so that his Padawan might escape, thereby allowing Shan to run and attempt to [[Force jump/Legends|jump]] into the departing craft. The corporal caught the Padawan mid-leap and pulled her into the freighter just before the ship slammed into the Imperial's interceptor and escaped into space. He and the young girl both operated the vessel's [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] in an effort to blast away attacking [[Mark VI Supremacy-class starfighter|Sith interceptors]] while the smuggler made the jump to hyperspace. After narrowly avoiding collisions with a battlecruiser, the freighter jumped to hyperspace, escaping Korriban.<ref name="Return" />

====The Alderaan triumph====
{{Quote|For centuries, Alderaan stood as a beacon of hope in the Republic. But the Empire came, and with one savage strike, brought Alderaan to her knees. Now, time is running out as few are left to face the enemy.|Captain Jace Malcom|<ref name="Hope" />}}
[[File:HopeTrailer-TOR.png|thumb|right|250px|Jace Malcom and his comrades fighting on Alderaan.]]
The war continued for a further twenty-eight years,<ref name="war length">According to ''[[Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire]]'', the [[Great Galactic War]] began twenty-eight years before the signing of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], which marked the end of the conflict.</ref> by the height of which Jace Malcom found new responsibility as the captain<ref name="JoMGD" /> of [[Havoc Squad|Infantry Squad 326]]&mdash;an elite special forces [[Squad/Legends|unit]] better known as Havoc Squad. Although the [[Squad/Legends|squad]] was attached to a larger [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] division within the army, it operated largely independently and specialized in irregular warfare.<ref name="HavocSquad">{{TORcite|type=codex|Havoc Squad}}</ref> In [[3667 BBY]],<ref name="AlderaanDate">[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']] indicates that the Battle of Alderaan occurs four years after the [[Battle of Bothawui (Second; Great Galactic War)|Battle of Bothawui]]. According to ''[[Timeline 5: The Battle of Bothawui]]'' the Battle of Bothawui occurs eighteen years before the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], which, as seen in ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'', is proposed and ratified in [[3653 BBY]]. Thusly, the Battle of Bothawui takes place in [[3671 BBY]], and the Battle of Alderaan occurs four years later, in [[3667 BBY]].</ref> Malcom and his squad-mates were stationed on the tranquil [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]<ref name="E3">{{TORweb|url=news/news-article/20100614_001|text=The Old Republic @ E3 2010|nolive=1}}</ref>&mdash;a planet seen by many as the embodiment of Republic ideals. There, the squad and many other Republic soldiers returning from tours on the front rested and recovered from exhaustion and injuries sustained on battlefields far away.<ref name="JoMGD" /> However, Alderaan's reputation as the Republic's spiritual center made the world into an enticing military target for the Sith Empire,<ref name="Alderaan">{{Holonet|planets|alderaan|Alderaan}}</ref> which launched a plan to destroy the world and capitalize on the damage it would cause to Republic morale.<ref name="E3" />

While Malcom and the rest of Havoc Squad remained on Alderaan's surface alongside other recovering Republic ground forces, the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] was called away from the planet in response to a diversionary feint set up by the recently-promoted [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Malgus&mdash;the same Sith who had engaged the Republic defenders at Korriban. While the planet's naval defenses were occupied elsewhere in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], Alderaan was [[Battle of Alderaan|besieged]] by a massive Imperial invasion. Led by Malgus, the Sith obliterated the local defenses and seized the world. Despite these initial successes, the Sith forces were unaware that the Republic forces stationed on the world had fled into Alderaan's forests and mountains to launch a guerrilla campaign against the Imperial advance. Malcom and Havoc Squad were among those who had gone to ground, but upon learning that Malgus was leading his forces in a march on Alderaan's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] city<ref name="Hope synopsis">{{TORweb|url=info/media/trailers/hope-cinematic-trailer|text="Hope"|int=Hope (cinematic trailer)}}</ref> and the [[Castle Organa|home]] of the ancient [[House of Organa/Legends|Organa]],<ref name="JoMGD" /> Malcom mobilized his forces for an all-out assault. The troopers of Havoc Squad, many of whom were still wounded and recovering, positioned themselves on a ridge outside of Alderaan's capital in the [[Juran Mountains/Legends|Juran Mountains]] in hopes of preventing the attack on the [[City/Legends|city]]<ref name="Juran">{{TORcite|type=codex|Juran Mountains}}</ref>&mdash;a goal that was widely perceived as a suicide mission.<ref name="JoMGD" /> Despite the obvious danger, when Darth Malgus led columns of [[Sith war droid Mark I|war droids]], [[Imperial soldier]]s, and [[Sith Warrior]]s in the march through the mountains, Malcom ambushed him, firing a hand-held [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] into the approaching forces. He and the rest of Havoc Squad proceeded to jump from the ridge down into the fray of battle, where they engaged an onslaught from the warriors and their troops. Malcom destroyed several more war droids before taking aim at Darth Malgus, who was able to deflect several of the cannon shots before being engulfed in the flames from one of the captain's projectiles. Seeing that Malgus survived the blast, Malcom rushed towards the Sith Lord to finish him off with a blade, but upon nearing the Sith Lord, he was assaulted with Force lightning before being [[Telekinesis/Legends|thrown]] backwards across the battlefield.<ref name="Hope" />

[[File:JaceMalcomFacingExecution-Hope.png|thumb|left|250px|Three Sith attempt to execute Malcom.]]
Captain Malcom was rendered unconscious by the attack, and upon awakening, found himself at the mercy of two Sith as he watched his comrades get beaten by Malgus and his forces. The two Sith dragged Malcom to a third who prepared to execute the helpless [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] via [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], but the three were instead thrown from the trooper by a repulsive blast from [[The Force/Legends|the Force]],<ref name="Hope" /> delivered by now-[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Satele Shan]], who had been tasked with defending Alderaan.<ref name="Satele Shan">{{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=5637093#edit5637093|text=Alexander Freed's post on SWTOR.com, confirming Satele's appearance in ''Hope''|nolive=1}}</ref> The Jedi's timely arrival saved Malcom and allowed Havoc Squad to refocus their assault while she continued onwards to engage Malgus. Malcom was provided with a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] from one of his fellow soldiers, and together they returned to the battlefield. He later realized that Darth Malgus had gained the upper hand in his duel against Shan, and so rushed to aid her. Malcom tackled Malgus, and while they grappled, he activated a [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]]. The blast threw the two combatants away from one another and grievously wounded both. Malcom was again rendered unconscious, awakening only after the battle had come to a close. Upon discovering that Malgus and his forces had been defeated, he fired a [[Flare/Legends|signal flare]] into the sky to indicate victory. The flare was matched by dozens of others fired by victorious Republic forces across the Alderaanian landscape, signaling the Empire's defeat on Alderaan.<ref name="Hope" /> After the battle, Shan and Malcom confessed to each other their mutual feelings and conceived a son, [[Theron Shan|Theron]].<ref name="Annihilation">''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]''</ref>

[[File:JaceMalcom-Hope.png|thumb|right|200px|Malcom was left with scars after Alderaan.]]
The battle catapulted Malcom and Havoc Squad to galactic fame and illustrated to military leaders the value of small, mobile units of elite soldiers.<ref name="HavocSquad" /> The victory on Alderaan also provided a temporary boon to Republic morale, which allowed the war effort to continue for over a decade.<ref name="JoMGD" /> Malcom continued to serve the Republic through [[3654 BBY]],<ref name="TreatyP">This date is extrapolated from [[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']], which indicates that the peace agreement was proposed one year prior to its ratification. According to ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'', the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] was implemented in [[3653 BBY]].</ref> when the Empire's [[Dark Council]] stunned the galaxy by offering a peace initiative. [[3653 BBY|The following year]], Republic and Imperial delegates convened on Alderaan to discuss a treaty, but the negotiations ultimately proved to be little more than a ruse&mdash;the Sith launched an [[Sacking of Coruscant|attack]] on the Republic capital of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and forced the negotiators to sign the [[Treaty of Coruscant]]. These final actions sealed the Empire's victory in the Great Galactic War and left the Republic broken, demoralized, and humbled.<ref name="JoMGD" /> Despite this, Malcom remained a loyal member of the military and helped the Republic to rebuild its alliances and martial integrity during the following years.<ref name="AlderaanBonus" />

===The Cold War===
====Promotions and politics====
Although the Treaty of Coruscant dictated that the Republic Military stand down in its fight against the Empire and that all war zones were to be surrendered to their Imperial claimants,<ref name="JoMGD" /> many within the Republic government refused to fully accept defeat. Proxy wars and small, unofficial resistance movements were fostered by military leaders, and during this period of conflicts known collectively as the interstellar [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the Republic readied itself for new battles against the Sith.<ref name="Art">''[[The Art and Making of Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> By this time, Malcom had been promoted out of Havoc Squad and was serving as an [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] to Republic military allies in his new role as a [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]].<ref name="AlderaanBonus" />

====Alderaan's Civil War====
{{Quote|House Organa has a real shot at winning this war now. Alderaan's been through so much. They deserve some peaceful times.|Colonel Malcom|<ref name="AlderaanBonus" />}}
[[File:Malcom_and_Brom.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Colonel Malcom and Major Brom plan strategy in Castle Organa.]]
Shortly after the signing of the Treaty of Coruscant, Alderaan was once again found embroiled in conflict. Because the world was so brutalized by the Empire during the invasion, its rulers were unwilling to accept the notion of peace with the Sith. [[Gaul Panteer]], [[Senator/Legends|senator]] and crown [[Prince/Legends|prince]] of Alderaan, angrily withdrew his world from the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the Republic and declared it an independent sovereignty. In the aftermath of this upheaval, both Panteer and his mother, [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Silara Panteer]], were killed under mysterious circumstances and the previously-banished [[House of Thul|House Thul]] returned from exile with Imperial support. These events led to the outbreak of a [[Alderaan Civil War|bloody civil war]] between the noble houses of Alderaan, all of whom were vying for the throne.<ref name="Alderaan" /> Although the former Republic [[General/Legends|general]] and Alderaan native [[Bouris Ulgo]] of [[House Ulgo]] made a nearly successful bid for the crown, his reign of terror in an attempt to subjugate the planet lost him the backing of the Republic and many other houses.<ref name="Bouris">{{TORcite|type=codex|Bouris Ulgo}}</ref> Instead, the Republic supported the efforts of House Organa, an ancient and noble lineage with strong ties to the galactic democracy.<ref name="Organa">{{TORcite|type=codex|House Organa}}</ref> Colonel Jace Malcom was dispatched to Alderaan to fill the role of [[Strategic Advisor to Alderaan for the Republic Army]] and leader of the [[First Alderaan Support Division]]. There, he was stationed in Castle Organa and worked closely with his [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] aide, [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Brom]], to ensure the safety and tactical superiority of House Organa's forces&mdash;a difficult task, given the Organas' inexperience in military affairs and traditional pacifism. Despite these shortfalls, many in house Organa, like [[Jeren Nolus Organa]], were extremely loyal to Malcom out of respect for his sacrifices for the planet during the Great War.<ref name="AlderaanBonus" />

[[File:Jace_Malcom_on_Coruscant.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Malcom was promoted to Supreme Commander during the Galactic War.]]
Following the defeat of Bouris Ulgo around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="CWDate">The Alderaan Civil War is a setting seen in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. [https://web.archive.org/web/20110716175922/http://www.swtor.com/community/showthread.php?p=5365704 This forum post] from ''The Old Republic''{{'s}} lead writer, [[Daniel Erickson]], indicates that the game takes place ten years after the signing of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]]. According to ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', the Treaty is signed in [[3653 BBY]], placing the conflict over Alderaan around [[3643 BBY]].</ref> Malcom continued to serve as a tactical advisor for the Organas as they rushed to capture land that was previously unavailable. Although the colonel attempted to temper their zeal, the Organas disregarded his advice and ultimately failed to secure their newly acquired territory. Malcom's investigations found that the [[King's Pass]] region was the most heinous instance of Organa oversight, and featured a large gap in defense. Knowing that House Organa would suffer heavy casualties from the splintering Ulgo forces, the upstarts in [[House Rist]], and the violent and territorial [[Species/Legends|species]] of Alderaanian [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoids]] known as the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]], the colonel arranged for a Republic combatant who had helped depose Ulgo to return to the planet. The two met with Major Brom in Malcom's offices in Castle Organa and began to discuss the importance of King's Pass and ways to seal the gap. While they spoke, they were interrupted by a communication from [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Ross (lieutenant)|Ross]], an officer stationed in the Pass. Ross and her forces were under attack from Killik raiders and House Ulgo soldiers, and were in need of immediate assistance. Colonel Malcom commanded the Republic combatant to go to King's Pass and relieve the fighters there while he worked with House Organa's leaders to refine their strategies. The combatant was ultimately successful, and their efforts overwhelmed House Organa's enemies and forced them to retreat from King's Pass. Colonel Malcom again met with the individual after the mission to debrief and thank them, noting that their efforts made peace on Alderaan a true possibility.<ref name="AlderaanBonus" />

===The Galactic War===
====Supreme Commander Malcom====
[[File:Republic_leaders.png|thumb|left|250px|Jace Malcom alongside Leontyne Saresh and Satele Shan.]]
Following the success of the Alderaan operation and renewed fighting on dozens of worlds, the Cold War came to a close and gave way to the [[Galactic War]]. The opening battles of this renewed conflict were devastating for both the Republic and Empire, and saw the deposition of the Republic's [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Dorian Janarus]]<ref>{{TORcite|[[Hunter (individual)|Bounty Hunter]] storyline}}</ref> and the supposed death of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]].<ref>{{TORcite|[[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] storyline}}</ref> During this upheaval, Malcom was again promoted, this time to serve as the successor to the human [[Rans]]<ref name="Rans">{{TORcite|type=codex|Supreme Commander Rans}}</ref> in the position of [[Supreme Commander (Republic)|Supreme Commander]] of the Republic Military. His tenure as the military's executive officer allowed him to work once more with Satele Shan, who now served as [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the Jedi Order. Together, the two of them fought against [[Darth Karrid]]'s renewed Imperial offensive in [[3640 BBY]].<ref name="Annihilation" />

====The Hutt Crisis====
In [[3638 BBY]],<ref name="TOR Dates Forums">{{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=9852711#edit9852711|text=Charles Boyd on Forums: "Dear Story Team, What Year Are We Currently In?" (1)}}</ref> Malcom appeared in a [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet]] broadcast following the conclusion of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] Crisis on [[Makeb]] alongside [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Leontyne Saresh]] and Satele Shan to announce the resolution of the Crisis, and the apparent death of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]].<ref name="Revenge of the Archon">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Empire|Revenge of the Archon|Makeb}}</ref> Following this, it was discovered that [[Regulator]] holdouts were still alive down on the surface with thousands of civilians who were believed to be dead, leading Malcom to devote Republic forces towards rescuing the people and securing the still-valuable world.<ref name="Mass Exodus">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Republic|Mass Exodus|Makeb}}</ref>

===Renewed Conflict===
====War on Iokath====
{{GameLSmechanics|Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne}}
[[File:JaceMalcomIokath.png|thumb|right|200px|Supreme Commander Malcom on Iokath]]
Many years later, in [[3629 BBY]],<ref name="TOR Dates Forums" /> following the [[War against Zakuul]] and the rise of the [[Eternal Alliance]], Malcom sent Republic forces to the artificial world of [[Iokath]] in the hopes of securing a [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] called [[Tyth]] for the Republic. While there his forces came into conflict with forces sent by [[Darth Acina|Empress Acina]], who was similarly after the superweapon. When the [[Alliance Commander]] heard of this, they traveled to Iokath to speak with Malcom and Acina about their trespassing of the world. Malcom sent [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Elara Dorne]] as an emissary to broker an alliance with the Commander, and similarly, Acina sent [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Malavai Quinn]] for the same purpose. Ultimately, the Alliance Commander decided to work with Malcom and the Republic.<ref name="The Forgotten World">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=general|The Forgotten World|Iokath}}</ref>

This prompted Acina to launch an attack on Republic held territory. With few other options, Malcom asked the Commander to assist in fighting off the Imperial soldiers, to which they agreed.<ref name="Shots Fired">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=general|Shots Fired|Iokath}}</ref> The Alliance Commander, along with [[Theron Shan]] and [[Lana Beniko]], met with Malcom, and discussed that in order to properly defeat Acina, they would need some of Iokath's weaponry. However, when the Commander and Shan left to find some, they discovered that the superweapon both sides were after had actually eradicated all life on Iokath when it was last used in the [[Iokath Civil War]], including their [[Unidentified Iokath species|original creators]]. Returning to Malcom, they received a call from Acina, who had claimed to find a backdoor into the superweapon. Despite urging her to stop, Acina continued trying to access the superweapon to use it against the Republic. Because of this, Malcom presented the Commandeer with the [[Nova Strider]], asking them to use it to go stop Acina.<ref name="The Lost Arsenal">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=general|The Lost Arsenal|Iokath}}</ref>

[[File:Supreme_Commander_Malcom_on_Iokath.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Malcom on Iokath addresses the Alliance Commander.]]
The Alliance Commander then left, rushing to stop Acina from using the weapon. Unfortunately, they were too late to stop Acina from attempting to access it, which led to her sudden death, and the awakening of Tyth and the other [[Six Gods|Old Gods]]. The Alliance Commander used the [[Eternal Fleet]] to momentarily pacify Tyth, but this was only a temporary solution, and the Commander would later need to return to Iokath to [[Machine Gods crisis|destroy the Old Gods]]. Returning to the Republic base, Malcom told the Commander that the Imperial forces were still fighting, even after the death of Acina. He expressed that in order to keep them from claiming the superweapon, the Republic would need to continue hammering the Empire, day by day, hour by hour, until they won the war.<ref name="Showdown on Iokath">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=general|Showdown on Iokath|Iokath}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|What makes you so sure that House Organa can't win on their own?''"<br />"''Forty years of soldiering and more scars than I care to count. If this gap isn't covered, there will be blood.|A Republic combatant and Colonel Malcom|<ref name="AlderaanBonus" />}}
[[File:Trooper_vs_Malgus.png|thumb|right|250px|Jace Malcom struggles with Darth Malgus before activating his grenade.]]
Jace Malcom was extremely loyal to the Republic, and was willing to give his life to defend his government and people. He believed that, despite the strength of the enemy, hope for peace could be restored to the Republic and the galaxy through simple acts of courage in the face of those overwhelming odds.<ref name="Hope" /> These values were his motivation for work in the Republic Military&mdash;a career that spanned well over forty years and numerous battles and injuries. His dedication and spirit lent to his ability as a soldier and facilitated his gradual ascent through the ranks of military hierarchy.<ref name="AlderaanBonus" /> As a corporal, Malcom served the Republic fiercely, and defended Korriban's orbital security station despite the simultaneous need to escape. He followed the orders issued by the Jedi, and was willing to work alongside a criminal who had been in Republic captivity only moments before the Sith assault began. At great personal risk, Malcom ensured Satele Shan's escape by descending the loading ramp of a freighter in-flight and pulling the Jedi aboard.<ref name="Return" />

[[File:Supreme_Commander_Malcom_is_focused.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Malcom's face betrays his emotions when facing his enemies.]]
As a captain of Havoc Squad, Malcom displayed extreme courage during the Battle of Alderaan, directly engaging the Sith forces despite his own forces being vastly outnumbered. Now in a command position, he led the charge against Malgus's troops, leaping from atop a high ridge directly into the heat of battle with the Sith. Throughout the battle he gunned for Malgus himself, and charged headlong into combat against the enemy commander several times. During his first attack, Malcom was assaulted by a barrage of Force lightning but managed to withstand its effects for a period of time while continuing to approach the Sith Lord. In the second instance, he activated a grenade while still holding it in his hand, nearly killing himself in order to successfully wound Darth Malgus.<ref name="Hope" /> These actions engendered the people of Alderaan to Malcom personally and led to his promotion to colonel, at which point he shifted roles from frontline warrior to tactician and advisor. Even in his new capacity however, he worked to ensure the Republic's battlefield superiority in the hope that the wars might one day come to a close.<ref name="AlderaanBonus" />

[[File:Supreme_Commander_Malcom.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Malcom in his Supreme Commander uniform]]
Over the course of his career, Malcom established a strong relationship with the Jedi Satele Shan. The two fought together on Korriban and Alderaan, and again later during Darth Karrid's offensive. They saved each other's lives several times during these engagements and Shan remarked in an entry in the [[Jedi Archives (Tython)|Jedi Archives]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] that she trusted the soldier as much as she trusted any of her fellow Jedi.<ref name="JoMGD" /> Likewise, Malcom enjoyed fighting alongside the Jedi, and those positive experiences made him eager to work with more Jedi in the future.<ref name="AlderaanBonus" /> This disposition put him at odds with many in the Republic government and military after the Sacking of Coruscant, as the Jedi were widely blamed for the Republic's loss of the war.<ref name="Timeline1">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant|int=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant}}</ref> Malcom similarly developed a strong connection to the planet Alderaan and its people. Despite the frustration he faced in advising the inexperienced House Organa, Malcom tackled the project with zeal in the hope that after a devastating invasion and a bloody civil war, the Alderaanian people could finally enjoy long-awaited peace.<ref name="AlderaanBonus" />

In addition to moderate facial hair, he sported several facial scars prior to the Battle of Alderaan. After the conclusion of the conflict, the right side of his face was heavily disfigured as a result of the close quarters explosion from his grenade and the impact he suffered after being thrown by the force of the blast.<ref name="Hope" />

==Equipment==
[[File:Jace_Malcom_aims_blaster.jpg|thumb|250px|left|Jace Malcom aims his blaster.]]
Jace Malcom was outfitted with the standard [[Color/Legends|white-and-orange]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]] of a Republic trooper during the Great Galactic War. While fighting above Korriban, he made use of a blaster cannon, as well as a laser chaingun and a missile launcher. During the battle, the corporal lost his helmet,<ref name="Return" /> and on Alderaan he elected not to utilize one. He kept a [[Knife/Legends|combat knife]] in a sheath on his chest and in battle on the Core World he again wielded a portable blaster cannon. Malcom also made use of grenades and signal flares during the conflict on Alderaan.<ref name="Hope" /> During the Cold War, Malcom eschewed the common garb of fabric uniforms that were favored by military leaders and instead continued to wear a suit of trooper armor, largely identical to that which he had worn throughout the Great War.<ref name="AlderaanBonus" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jace Malcom first appeared, albeit unnamed, in [[Hope (cinematic trailer)|''Hope'']], the second cinematic trailer for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]]. The trailer, released by BioWare on [[June 14]] of [[2010]], depicts the trooper as the narrator, explaining events on Alderaan prior to the skirmish featured in the trailer. He later received a brief mention in [[Paul S. Kemp]]'s short story "[[The Old Republic: The Third Lesson]]" and novel ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]''. The character later appeared in [[Return (cinematic trailer)|''Return'']], the third cinematic trailer for the game, released on [[June 6]], [[2011]]. Following these appearances and mentions, the character was commonly depicted in promotional work for ''The Old Republic'' to represent the Republic Trooper class and archetype in the game itself. The trooper was finally given his name in an interview with [[Charles Boyd]], Bioware's Lead Writer for the Trooper class in ''The Old Republic''.<ref name="Jace">{{WebCite|url=http://www.republictrooper.com/2011/09/20/biowares-charles-boyd-shares-intel-about-the-story-of-the-trooper|text=Bioware's Charles Boyd Shares Intel About The Story Of The Trooper|author=Charles Boyd|date=2011-09-20|work=Republictrooper.com|archivedate=20110924031246}}</ref>

''The Old Republic'' was released on [[December 20]] of 2011 and featured Malcom as a non-player character seen in cutscene conversations with Republic-aligned player characters on Alderaan. Malcom is the primary objective-giver in the extended mission called "Alderaan: Bonus Series." In the game as well as the trailers, Malcom is voiced by veteran ''[[Star Wars]]'' voice actor [[Kevin Michael Richardson]].<ref name="credits">{{TORcite|Credit reel}}</ref> Malcom appeared once again in [[2012]] within the pages of [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s novel ''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]''.

===Gameplay alternatives===
[[File:Death_of_Jace_Malcom.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Jace Malcom speaks the last words to his son before death.]]
During the [[War on Iokath]], the player must side with either the Empire or the Republic, possibly against their original faction, neither of which is a light or dark side choice. If the player sides with the Empire, and thus Acina instead of Malcom, Malcom will launch an all out attack on Imperial territory, and the Alliance Commander will be asked to aid the Empire. Following this, the story plays out almost exactly the same, but with Acina and Malcom's positions in the story swapped. This will eventually lead to Malcom's death when he tries to activate the superweapon. Malcom will die in the arms of his son, Theron Shan, asking him to tell Satele that he was sorry.<ref name="Showdown on Iokath" />
